about: Ticket C's starts: the record's census of every start of three to five knots with single meetings, each once up to isomorphism, in the record's order (rebuilt from its description and equal to the list in artifacts/RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001B/RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001B-E001_reference/census/results.jsonl.gz, order and set-aside flags included). Fields: id (n<knots>-g<graph-atlas index>-<loose counts>), n, g, loose, labelled (n! / number of automorphisms of the graph keeping the loose counts: the number of numberings of the start's knots, the weight of the labelled weighting), set_aside_parity (a start knot fails the parity knot test at round 0; under not-all-equal every start knot of these passes). stars: one shared distinction per edge in sorted edge order, then the loose distinctions in knot order (rebuilt by the rule; not listed).

drafter_scratch_samples.about: The drafter's scratch census (disclosed in PC; not the registered census, which reads every start): every start of three and four knots, K = 2; 150 five-knot starts sampled uniformly without replacement (the census weighting) and 100 with replacement under the weight 'labelled' (the labelled weighting), indices into the five-knot starts in census order.

registered_samples.about: DC 1.5: every run reads its starts in this order (the permutation's indices into the census list), starts set aside under parity skipped under parity. The registered sizes are prefixes: R1a every start of the parity list; R1b the first 2,000 of the parity list; R1c the first 1,000 and R1d the first 120 of the full list (not-all-equal); R2 the first 500 of the parity list; the conditional R5's five-knot starts the first 300 five-knot starts of the order. A run cut for time is cut to the first half or the first quarter of its registered prefix. R7 and R8 use the census order itself (R7: the first 6 three-knot starts and the first 2 four-knot starts; R8: the 219 starts of three and four knots).
